caption_L1: Share of votes in the Danish Parliament election in 2015 and 2019 , by party is a bar chart. There is a categorical scale with Alternativet on one end and Venstre, Danmarks Liberale Parti at the other along the x-axis, labeled political party. There is a linear scale of range 0.00 to 0.25 along the y-axis, marked 2019.
caption_L2L3: There are two parties which seem to have dominated the election. There were five parties which receved comparatively few votes. Five further parties received substantialy more votes, but did not approach the two major parties. The Social Democrats won quite easily, but may have had more difficulty if some of the smaller parties and individuals did not run and gave their votes to the Liberals.
